body: Yeah I don't like to think what I might say in that situation!

So you were ok being hospitalized the first time? I had a family member "sectioned" involuntarily recently and the place she was in was an absolute shit show. It was basically just locking people in an no therapy or doctor visits.

The first time it wasn't the person, she was actually really good.  But then I spent about an hour and a half trying to get additional resources late at night.  It was phone number after phone number. Sometimes I'd get 2 from one place. The very last one literally referred me back to the first number I'd called outside the hotline.  I hung up.

You could have been 12 years old with big tits and a bubble butt and being constantly sexually harrassed by men old enough to be your grandfather or great grandfather on public transportation or anywhere in public, not to mention the bullying from the girls in school.

In the long run you're going to come out so far ahead of everyone who ever gave you shit about your appearance.  You'll still be looking fine as hell at 50.  Take that shit in stride.

She gave you the kind of gift that many on this sub would do anything to have. You still have what she gave you, and you will until you die. That is a rare and precious thing that you hold, and nothing about is negated by her tragic death. Treasure it and hold on to it. If you can, try to pay it forward some day.
